data.description:
Observed during Option A story implementation (2026-06-03): the `mktemp-tmpdir-check` pre-commit hook reproducibly exits 124 (timeout) at its own 30s wrapper budget on commits touching multiple shell scripts, blocking the commit. Workaround used: SKIP=mktemp-tmpdir-check after verifying the changed scripts pass the check directly (rc=0) and follow CLAUDE.md mktemp templates.

Impact: forces a hook-skip on legitimate commits; risks masking real mktemp violations if skipped habitually.
Observed: exit 124 at 30s; the three changed scripts each pass the check when run directly.
Not yet investigated: whether the timeout is total-runtime (too many files) or a hang in the check itself.
data.title: mktemp-tmpdir-check pre-commit hook times out (exit 124) at 30s wrapper budget on multi-script commits
